# Shedevrum AI

> > Shedevrum AI is a platform that utilizes Yandex Cloud infrastructure with SmartCaptcha security for bot detection and access verification.

The site implements robust security measures through Yandex's SmartCaptcha technology to protect against automated requests and ensure legitimate user access. All available pages currently show security verification endpoints.

## Key Topics

- SmartCaptcha
- Yandex Cloud
- Yandex
- Bot Detection
- Access Verification
- Automated Request Prevention
- Security Challenge
- Captcha Verification
- Cloud Security
